name: chrome-agent-bridge
description: Control and analyze user-approved Chrome tabs through a local MCP bridge, with local code, protocol, and WASM analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Control and monitor approved Chrome tabs through MCP.
interface.longDescription: A local, open-source Chrome bridge for Agents. It provides semantic page control, sanitized monitoring, explicit Raw CDP, script and source-map analysis, debugger and profiler workflows, opt-in deep network inspection, and offline JavaScript, binary, protocol, and WASM analysis.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my current Chrome tab and summarize the page.
Monitor requests while I perform an action in Chrome.
Debug scripts on the approved tab and detach when finished.
Analyze this JavaScript or protocol payload locally.
